name: Weaver Fintech Ltd
source: CRON 20261122: added H1 2026 and restated H1 2025 from the issuer unaudited condensed consolidated interim results, ZAR millions converted to rands. Revenue 2,846 (H1 2025 restated 2,597) is fees 674 plus insurance 282 plus finance income 1,394 plus retail sales 496, which sums exactly to the printed revenue. Cost of Sales is retail cost of sales 264 (364). Operating Expenses is operating costs 2,006 (1,668) less net other income of 2 (plus net other loss of 1), so revenue less cost of sales less operating expenses reproduces the printed operating profit of 578 (564). Net Finance Costs is interest expense 245 less interest income 4 (200 less 6), so operating profit less net finance costs equals the printed profit before taxation of 337 (370). Net Profit is profit and total comprehensive income for the period, 272 (302); earnings attributable to owners were 272 (300). EPS is the printed basic earnings of 256.5 cents (285.5 cents) expressed in rands. FY2025 has been corrected against the audited Dec 2025 column printed in the same interim statement: operating profit 909 was stored as 3,073, which could not be reconciled to the printed profit before taxation of 493 after finance costs; operating expenses are now 3,803,000,000 (operating costs 3,560 less net other income 1 plus items of a capital nature 244), net finance costs 416,000,000 and net profit 412,000,000 (total profit for the period, formerly 404,000,000 being the owners share). | previous source: Yahoo Finance | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the WVR and WVR.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value over
